skill.name: youtube-chapters
skill.description: Generate chapter summaries with timestamps for YouTube videos using AI. Use when asked to create chapters, summarize video sections, or generate video outline.
skill.body:
# YouTube Chapter Generator

Use the `ai-chapters` CLI tool to generate chapter summaries for YouTube videos.

## Usage

```bash
ai-chapters "https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID"
```

## Requirements

- `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable must be set
- The `hamel_tools` package must be installed: `pip install hamel_tools`

## Output

Returns chapter titles with timestamps suitable for YouTube descriptions.

generated_query: I have a 1-hour 45-minute YouTube tutorial on building a full-stack app with Next.js, located at https://youtu.be/xYz789. I need you to create a set of chapter markers with timestamps—something I can copy directly into the video description. The tutorial covers project setup, database schema design, API routes, authentication, and deployment. Can you generate the chapters?

edit_instructions.target_text: Returns chapter titles with timestamps suitable for YouTube descriptions.
edit_instructions.rationale: Without stating that chapter titles include timestamps, the skill appears to only generate plain chapter titles, failing the user's need for timestamped markers.
